questions.question: Which type of drum switch is used for forward and reverse control of a three-phase induction motor?
questions.explanation: Forward/reverse drum switch controls motor direction. It is used for clockwise and anti-clockwise rotation.
explanationLines: Forward/reverse drum switch controls motor direction.
It is used for clockwise and anti-clockwise rotation.
questions.subject: industrial-installation-and-maintenance

questions.question: What is the purpose of a motor protection circuit breaker (MPCB)?
options: To protect the motor from overloads and faults
questions.correctOption: To protect the motor from overloads and faults
questions.explanation: MPCB protects motors from overloads and faults. It combines protection functions for motor circuits.
explanationLines: MPCB protects motors from overloads and faults.
It combines protection functions for motor circuits.
questions.subject: industrial-installation-and-maintenance

questions.question: Which motor control accessory is used to prevent overloading in motors?
questions.explanation: OLR senses overload in motors. It disconnects supply when current exceeds a preset level.
explanationLines: OLR senses overload in motors.
It disconnects supply when current exceeds a preset level.
questions.subject: industrial-installation-and-maintenance

questions.question: What does a star/delta switch control in a three-phase motor?
questions.explanation: Star-delta starting reduces starting current. Delta running gives higher torque for normal operation.
explanationLines: Star-delta starting reduces starting current.
Delta running gives higher torque for normal operation.
questions.subject: industrial-installation-and-maintenance

questions.question: What is the function of an inching and holding system in motor control?
options: To control the motor from two locations
To enable precise positioning and maintain operation
To protect the motor from short circuits
questions.correctOption: To enable precise positioning and maintain operation
questions.explanation: Inching runs only while the start button is pressed. Holding keeps the motor running until stop is pressed.
explanationLines: Inching runs only while the start button is pressed.
Holding keeps the motor running until stop is pressed.
questions.subject: industrial-installation-and-maintenance

questions.question: When a contactor is de-energized, it is in the……… position.
questions.explanation: A normally open contact closes when the coil is energized. When de-energized, that contact remains open.
explanationLines: A normally open contact closes when the coil is energized.
When de-energized, that contact remains open.
questions.subject: industrial-installation-and-maintenance

questions.question: In a DOL starter, what happens when a start push button is pressed?
options: The motor starts with a reduced voltage
The motor starts at full voltage
questions.correctOption: The motor starts at full voltage
questions.explanation: The motor windings are directly connected to supply. Full line voltage is applied to the motor.
explanationLines: The motor windings are directly connected to supply.
Full line voltage is applied to the motor.

questions.question: Which type of the motors are typically started using the Star-Delta starter?

questions.question: What function is controlled using a simple drum-type forward/reverse switch?
